column1: # Natural Earth shapefiles needed by the figures of LorenzCycleToolkit (Cartopy pre-existing data layout).
# Point CARTOPY_DATA_DIR to a directory holding these files; the tests verify them and never download them.
# 15 sets: coastline, land, ocean and admin_0_boundary_lines_land at 110m, 50m and 10m (Cartopy picks the scale from the map extent);
# admin_0_countries, admin_1_states_provinces_lines and populated_places at 50m (fixed in the code). 75 files.
